description: Shared deterministic starting substrate for STUDY-209. Branching topology with a result-dependent (conditional) edge at 'gate' and a self-modification trigger at 'mutate' (which, when executed, adds an 'audit' node + the edges that carry traversal through it). Deterministic node ops + primitive vocabulary so functional equivalence across storage loci is a decidable structural diff. The self-modification's effect must be observed by the NEXT traversal step on the persisted-and-modified substrate (this is what must survive the network boundary). Vocabulary is aligned to the STUDY-208 (#2577) substrate contract for cross-study comparability (ADR-003); baseline_authored_by: STUDY-209 (STUDY-208 not committed to main at authoring time, B1).
